instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the visual direction explicitly requested by the user is honored: 'Premium luxury jewellery aesthetic. Warm ivory backgrounds. Champagne gold accents. Deep charcoal typography. Elegant typography. Spacious layouts. Premium product imagery. Minimal, desktop-first but responsive.'
DO NOT use generic blue SaaS gradients or standard AI landing page look. Use warm ivory (#FAF8F5) with rich dark charcoal (#1C1917) and delicate champagne gold accents (#D4AF37).
All interactive elements and inputs MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-input', data-testid='generate-btn', data-testid='plan-starter-btn').

Provide a full interactive mock application flow: Landing Page -> Auth Modal / Page -> Dashboard -> AI Studio Workspace (with real upload drag-and-drop preview, preset picker, generating progress bar simulation, before/after compare slider, download button) -> AI Model Photography Studio -> Background Removal Studio -> Projects & Gallery -> Billing with Razorpay checkout drawer.
Use Shadcn UI components for dialogs, accordions, dropdowns, tabs, select, and sliders, customized with warm ivory and gold borders.
Ensure smooth scrolling and responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Never use transition: all. Specify properties like transition-colors, transition-transform.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_center_app: Do NOT center-align global text or app container.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use Sonner for toast notifications on actions like image generation, download, copy link, and razorpay payment simulation.
